eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Lake, CA; at 3:48 PM on SEP 10, 2026 Effective until 7:48 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Lake County Sheriff issued an EVACUATION ORDER at 03:48 PM on 09-10-2026 in the area of Elk Mtn / Mendo Forest for zones MNF-E016, MNF-E018, UPP-E023 due to Wildfire (Incendio). LEAVE NOW. Visit Response at Ready.LakeCountyCA.gov for more details as available or call 211.
